why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Austin Riley is slot #4 (4.582 expected team runs/game).
Slots #4, #2, #3, #5, #1, #6, #7, #8, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #6 ranks 6 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.005 R/G.
Slot #4 yields 4.35 expected PA/game vs 4.14 at primary slot #6. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
